On February 16, 2023, I uploaded the first chapter of "Pretending to be Alice", and now I want to share the new version.
https://discord.com/invite/sBhCXznHmb — essentially an inactive channel where I occasionally share thoughts and talk about new works (mostly short novels).
https://boosty.to/cutemente/donate — the page is still available if anyone wants to treat me to a coffee or a shot of something stronger. (Though, given the platform's limitations, just a "wish" alone isn't enough.)
The remaster is already done, but I still need to double-check the text, so I'll be uploading the remaining parts over the course of a month.

update: 19.02.2026 - page 84
